newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates move lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates move lower across the board.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) moved lower across all maturities on Tuesday after the Central Bank trimmed its overnight rates, traders said.

The Central Bank on Tuesday had cut its overnight borrowing and lending rates by 0.1875 percentage points each to 10.25 and 12.75 percent, respectively. Its action was in step with the steep fall in Treasury bill rates in Monday's auction.
Dealers said banks are awash with liquidity as they continue to stay away from term reverse repos which have a 20 percent tax.
